requested_source: Raw two-cell dynamic-clamp records underlying Latimer2019 Figure3, or a new matched independent ON-parasol record

arrays.time_s: Explicit sampled times, reference/trigger, sample rate and clock for each record
arrays.voltage_V: Raw physical membrane voltage per cell and repeat; no synthetic voltage inferred from currents
arrays.spike_times_s: Per-repeat detected spike times on the same physical clock, plus detector/export definition
arrays.trial_table: Cell, animal/species, trial, condition, waveform/repeat group, recording mode and source identities
arrays.injected_input: Applied gE/gI, Eexc/Einh, common scaling and holding/bias current when recorded; identify unavailable fields

metadata_required: Primary source locator, file hash, author variable definitions and physical units
Voltage origin, liquid-junction correction and whether already applied; no assumed 10mV shift
Sampling, spike detection/index origin, filters, resampling, trigger and voltage/spike alignment
Exact Fig3 cell IDs and mapping to animal/species, ON-parasol identification and recording conditions
Dynamic-clamp reversal potentials, applied conductance scale and DC injection for each condition
Original repeat-mean voltage preprocessing, spike treatment and interval exclusions

proposed_analysis.fixed_parameters: Existing alpha=150Hz, C/gL/reversals, voltage-valued three-bin history and dt=1ms remain fixed
proposed_analysis.observation: Existing HistoryRGC softplus and 1-exp(-lambda*dt) binary likelihood
proposed_analysis.binning: Predeclare conversion of original times/voltage to retained bin sampling; reject multiple events/bin, no clipping or fit-selected time shifts
proposed_analysis.mean_voltage: Build the measured repeat-mean voltage independently within each declared split; never pool heldout targets into training preprocessing
proposed_analysis.split: Predeclare disjoint waveform/condition groups. If only one repeated 19s waveform exists, disjoint time blocks must be held together across repeats with history guard and the limited within-condition claim stated
proposed_analysis.independence: No reuse of the already-inspected Cell6 holdout as a new independent test; new cells/stimuli required for broader generalization claims
proposed_analysis.bounds: Declare justified units/bounds and selection criterion before fitting; do not expand after heldout inspection
proposed_analysis.candidate: Save source identities, exact coefficient delta, split hashes, training/validation/test likelihood and uncertainty; unadopted ON-parasol module only
proposed_analysis.standard_control: Only after candidate acceptance: compare the frozen short fullfield_flash_pair protocol under identical inputs and preparation; no new optical capture or long background without required authorization
proposed_analysis.physiological_claim: A measured-voltage conditional output fit does not calibrate passive membrane or upstream conductances
